## Foods & dishes
- [[WorldCuisines]]: 5 dishes (1 Mali-only: ngome); [[FmLAMA]]: 1 (maafe).
- [[World Wide Dishes]]: 1 dish (sweet-potato-leaf stew), written in Lingala from Kinshasa/Katanga, so probably mis-tagged.

## Ingredients & food composition
- No national FCT is in the vault. The [[FAO INFOODS global databases]] candidate (priority 2, directory of 308 tables) includes the FAO/INFOODS **West African Food Composition Table (WAFCT)**, a regional table for the ECOWAS countries including Mali; processing it is the most direct way to get local foods (fonio, cowpea, shea, baobab, leafy sauces). Until then, use [[USDA FoodData Central]] by name matching.
- [[CMAUP]]: 66 plants; [[NPASS]]: 19 pairs.

## Compounds & traditional medicine
- No Duke records. [[KNApSAcK Family]] lists Mali on its World map, but African flag pages were not scraped (counts unknown).
- Compound → effect chains come from the global backbone via [[Global]] ([[FooDB]], [[CTD]], [[Phenol-Explorer]], [[SpiceRx]], [[DDID]] for food–drug interactions).

## Gaps
- Almost no Malian food data; WAFCT (which includes Mali) not yet processed.
